svg.title: The precession line and its structure
svg.desc: Spectrum of the precession signal at two coherence times. With the short one the four Zeeman transitions merge into a single broadened line; with a long one they resolve into four separate peaks.
svg.text: THE LINE, AND WHAT IS INSIDE IT
frequency − g_F μ_B B / h / Hz
The sticks are the four F=2 transitions, 36 Hz apart at this field, with the weights a π/2 tip gives them.
At Γ_g = 170 s⁻¹ the Lorentzian width is 54 Hz and they merge into one line that is wider than any of them.
Nothing here resolves the structure away. It is still in the signal, and it still beats — see the previous figure.
